dataSources.name: Google Search Console performance
dataSources.systemOfRecord: Search Console URL-prefix property https://delight0517.github.io/selah-bible-meditation/ queried through the GSC Wizard API
dataSources.refresh: On request; Search Console reports lag by roughly 2–3 days
limitations: 0 clicks and 0 impressions means CTR is not calculable
Zero rows do not establish that a page has no visits
Search Console aggregates are not copied into the repository

dataSources.name: First-party Selah page-view aggregates
dataSources.systemOfRecord: cloud-account-storage Worker analytics summary for appId=selah
datasets: country/device/locale/path buckets when source fields exist
limitations: Some historical rows have unresolved origin mixing
Do not assign an unknown-origin path to Selah
This is separate from feature experiment counts in analytics-worker

dataSources.name: Selah feature and acquisition experiment aggregates
dataSources.systemOfRecord: analytics-worker Cloudflare Worker and its D1 aggregate database
limitations: Approximate event/browser counts, not verified people
Do not infer causality or a winner below the documented sample rule

dataSources.name: Google Analytics 4 website and country/device reports

datasets: users/sessions/page views by country, device, landing page
dataSources.refresh: Unavailable until a GA4 property is linked and site collection is verified
dataSources.coverage: No GA4 property connected; no site measurement ID verified
limitations: Google account currently lacks Analytics OAuth scope
Do not guess a measurement ID or claim GA4 tracking before readback
Consent and privacy disclosure must match the approved collection
